brief_summary: Hyperglycemia in the hospital is associated with multiple adverse outcomes. Previously, the mobile insulin scheme was used for its control. However, in the last decade, several studies have shown that the insulin basal-bolus (basal plus) regimen is associated with better glycemic control and a lower risk of hypoglycemia.
brief_title: Comparison of 2 Hyperglycemia-correction Scales in Hospitalized Patients

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with diabetes mellitus who presented hyperglycemia (above 140 mg/dl) located in the general ward, emergency room or hospitalization and who received a basal or basal bolus insulin scheme.

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnancy, with acute decompensation of diabetes (diabetic ketoacidosis-hyperosmolar state) or type 1 diabetes

official_title: Comparison of 2 Hyperglycemia-correction Scales in Hospitalized Patients in an Institution in Bogotá, Colombia

primary_outcomes.measure: Number of paticipants with Glicemic control
